; Proof obligations for arith.py, formalized from spec.md
; ========================================================
;
; Format : SMT-LIB 2 (accepted natively by the chosen checker, Z3)
; Checker: z3 -smt2 -file:obligations.txt
;
; Each obligation is stated exactly as in spec.md: a universally quantified
; equation over ALL integers. To *prove* an obligation, we assert its
; negation and ask the solver for a satisfying assignment; the obligation is
; proved iff the result is `unsat` (no counterexample exists).
;
; Definitions mirror the implementation in arith.py:
;   add(a, b)      -> a + b
;   multiply(a, b) -> a * b

(define-fun add ((a Int) (b Int)) Int (+ a b))
(define-fun multiply ((a Int) (b Int)) Int (* a b))

; --------------------------------------------------------------------
; Obligation 1 — spec.md Law 1: add is commutative
;   forall a b in Z:  add(a, b) = add(b, a)
; Expected: unsat  (proved)
; --------------------------------------------------------------------
(push)
(assert
  (not
    (forall ((a Int) (b Int))
      (= (add a b) (add b a)))))
(check-sat)
(pop)

; --------------------------------------------------------------------
; Obligation 2 — spec.md Law 2: add is associative
;   forall a b c in Z:  add(add(a, b), c) = add(a, add(b, c))
; Expected: unsat  (proved)
; --------------------------------------------------------------------
(push)
(assert
  (not
    (forall ((a Int) (b Int) (c Int))
      (= (add (add a b) c) (add a (add b c))))))
(check-sat)
(pop)

; --------------------------------------------------------------------
; Obligation 3 — spec.md Law 3: multiply is commutative
;   forall a b in Z:  multiply(a, b) = multiply(b, a)
; Expected: unsat  (proved)
; --------------------------------------------------------------------
(push)
(assert
  (not
    (forall ((a Int) (b Int))
      (= (multiply a b) (multiply b a)))))
(check-sat)
(pop)

; --------------------------------------------------------------------
; Obligation 4 — spec.md Law 4: multiply is associative
;   forall a b c in Z:  multiply(multiply(a, b), c)
;                                     = multiply(a, multiply(b, c))
; Expected: unsat  (proved)
; --------------------------------------------------------------------
(push)
(assert
  (not
    (forall ((a Int) (b Int) (c Int))
      (= (multiply (multiply a b) c)
         (multiply a (multiply b c))))))
(check-sat)
(pop)

; --------------------------------------------------------------------
; Obligation 5 — spec.md Law 5: multiply distributes over add
;   forall a b c in Z:  multiply(a, add(b, c))
;                                     = add(multiply(a, b), multiply(a, c))
; Expected: unsat  (proved)
; --------------------------------------------------------------------
(push)
(assert
  (not
    (forall ((a Int) (b Int) (c Int))
      (= (multiply a (add b c))
         (add (multiply a b) (multiply a c))))))
(check-sat)
(pop)
